UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered reader or administrator profile for maktabada.so, including role, saved favorite book IDs, and presence metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

name.description: Display name of the reader or administrator.

email.description: User email address (PII - restricted to owner and admins).

bio.description: Short personal bio written by the reader.

avatarUrl.description: Firebase Storage URL, HTTPS image URL, or compact resized avatar thumbnail for the user's profile picture.

favorites.description: Bounded list of book IDs favorited by the user (max 100).

dailyReadingGoalMinutes.description: User-configured daily reading goal in minutes per day (5 to 480).

dailyReminderEnabled.description: Whether daily reading reminder notifications are enabled for the user.

dailyReminderTime.description: Preferred daily reading reminder time in 24-hour HH:MM format.

online.description: Whether the user is currently active in the library.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent presence update.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

Book.title: Book
Book.description: Digital book or monograph entry in the maktabada.so catalog.

title.description: Book title in Somali or other supported languages.

coverUrl.description: Cover image URL, bundled asset path, or compact HD WebP cover data URL.

fileUrl.description: Firebase Storage URL for the downloadable/previewable book file (PDF/EPUB/TXT).

fileName.description: Original filename of the uploaded book document.

fileType.description: Format of the book file (pdf, epub, txt, article).

allowDownload.description: Controls whether readers can download the file or read online only.

published.description: Controls visibility in the public catalog.

contentText.description: Readable text body for the built-in online reader.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who added the book.

ratingSum.description: Cumulative sum of all user star ratings (1-5) for this book.

ratingCount.description: Total number of user star ratings submitted for this book.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the book was published.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest book metadata update.

BookRating.title: BookRating
BookRating.description: Individual signed-in reader star rating (1 to 5) for a book.

userId.description: UID of the reader who submitted the rating.

bookId.description: ID of the rated book document.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the rating was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest rating update.

ReadingProgress.title: ReadingProgress
ReadingProgress.description: Tracks a signed-in reader's current page and percentage progress for a book.

bookId.description: ID of the book being read.

totalPages.description: Estimated or configured total page count (1 to 10000).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when reading progress was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest reading progress update.

BookComment.title: BookComment
BookComment.description: Reader discussion comment on a published book in maktabada.so.

userId.description: UID of the reader who wrote the comment.

bookId.description: ID of the parent book document.

authorName.description: Public display name of the commenter (no email/PII).

published.description: Visibility flag synced with the published parent book.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the comment was posted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest comment edit.

DailyReadingLog.title: DailyReadingLog
DailyReadingLog.description: Tracks total active reading seconds per calendar day for a signed-in user to calculate their 15-minute daily reading streak.

dateKey.description: Local calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

secondsRead.description: Total active reading seconds accumulated on this date (0 to 86400).

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the daily reading log was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest daily reading time update.

BookFileChunk.title: BookFileChunk
BookFileChunk.description: Ordered base64 binary chunk of a PDF or EPUB book file stored directly inside Firestore.

bookId.description: ID of the parent book document.

totalChunks.description: Total number of chunks belonging to this book file (1 to 60).

mimeType.description: MIME type of the reassembled file (e.g. application/pdf).

dataBase64.description: Base64-encoded binary slice of the book file.

published.description: Visibility flag synced with the parent book.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who uploaded this file chunk.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the chunk was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest chunk update.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles, role assignments, favorite book lists, and Firestore presence mirror.

/users/{userId}/progress/{bookId}.description: Per-user per-book reading page and percentage progress for resuming where the user left off.

/users/{userId}/readingLogs/{dateKey}.description: Per-user per-day active reading seconds for computing consecutive 15-minute reading streaks.

/books/{bookId}.description: Digital library catalog of books, covers, aggregate star ratings, and reader text.

/books/{bookId}/fileChunks/{chunkId}.description: Ordered binary file chunks for PDF/EPUB books uploaded directly without external storage.

/books/{bookId}/ratings/{userId}.description: Per-user star ratings (1-5) synchronized atomically with the parent book's ratingSum and ratingCount.

/books/{bookId}/comments/{commentId}.description: Reader discussion comments on published books.
